clue.text: Don't contact workers in their free time

definitions.meaning: a warning not to touch or interfere
hands are workers, and off means not on duty

explanation.surface: An instruction not to phone staff while they are on leave.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a command telling someone not to touch, and literally describes labourers who are off duty.

clue.text: Volume of praise

parts.note: volume reads as a book, and praise as hymns sung in church, not loudness of acclaim

explanation.definitionFit: A book of hymns is a volume whose contents are songs praising God.

clue.text: Rodin sculpted a number of blond, blue-eyed people

indicators.note: the sculptor's name is shaped into a new form, as he shaped stone

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: The sculptor Rodin modelled several fair-haired, blue-eyed figures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sculpted' works on the sculptor's own name, giving NORDI; the 'of' belongs to the definition, so the adjective fits 'of ... people'.
explanation.definitionFit: Nordic describes the Scandinavian peoples, stereotypically fair-haired with blue eyes.

clue.text: Deliberate way to enter the financial market

definitions.meaning: a verb here: to ponder or consider

definitions.text: way to enter the financial market
definitions.meaning: investing riskily in the hope of profit

explanation.surface: A calculated method for getting into trading.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder is to reflect at length, and in finance it also means buying shares or goods riskily for gain.

clue.text: Revealing, though unintentional, expression of a sinful pride, perhaps

indicators.note: signals that these letters might be arranged differently to give the answer

explanation.surface: A careless remark that accidentally betrays someone's sinful vanity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' tells you to rearrange all twelve letters of A SINFUL PRIDE; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A Freudian slip is a verbal mistake thought to reveal a hidden wish, named after the psychoanalyst.

clue.text: You can't be sure when nursing them

definitions.text: You can't be sure when nursing them

parts.words: You can't be sure when nursing them
parts.note: nursing suggests tending patients, but here one nurses misgivings, harbouring uncertainties

explanation.definitionFit: To nurse misgivings is to hold them, which leaves a person unsure.

clue.text: Reserved for skating

definitions.meaning: kept in waiting, put aside for later
where skaters perform, on a frozen rink

explanation.surface: A rink booked for skaters.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting a plan on hold is idiomatically chilling it, and skaters perform on a frozen surface.

clue.text: Ointment said to be used by the Royal Family

explanation.surface: A cream that rumour says the royals use.
explanation.walkthrough: BALMORAL is the British royal family's castle estate in Scotland. 'said' tempts a soundalike, but it just means ORAL.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish castle is a private residence of the British monarch and their family.

clue.text: Artful secret of not having to pay

indicators.note: artful suggests something crafted cunningly, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: The crafty trick of avoiding a bill.
explanation.definitionFit: To go without paying or without punishment is the idiom of escaping unpunished.

clue.text: Took life seriously

parts.note: sounds like being earnest, but read literally it means ending someone's life in a grave way

explanation.definitionFit: Killing someone is literally taking their life.

clue.text: Canal bridge in an industrial town

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of letters of these two words

explanation.surface: A bridge over a canal in a manufacturing town.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rialto is the famous bridge over the Grand Canal in Venice.

clue.text: Lacking a centre of gravity?

parts.note: a physics phrase, reread as having no heavy heart, the centre being the heart and gravity being seriousness

explanation.definitionFit: Someone cheerful and carefree has no heaviness of spirit at their core.

clue.text: Final word from new aide to union leader

indicators.note: new suggests the word aide made over into a fresh arrangement
the leader of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A newly appointed aide says goodbye to the head of a trade union.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges AIDE into ADIE; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The French farewell is a parting word said at the end of a meeting.

clue.text: Starts on the green and accelerates away

definitions.meaning: golfers begin a hole by hitting from the tee on the course

explanation.surface: A golfer begins the round and then speeds off.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf the opening long shot is a drive, and a motorist speeding away is also said to leave this way.

clue.text: Ham actor near to ruin in the long run

indicators.note: the letters are wrecked and rebuilt into a new order

explanation.surface: An overacting performer is close to disaster in the long term.
explanation.definitionFit: A race of about twenty-six miles is a run of great length.

clue.text: See chintz is ordered in sage

indicators.note: the letters are put into a different order

explanation.surface: A command to look at a fabric arranged in a herb colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordered' rearranges SEE CHINTZ. 'sage' looks like the herb or colour; it means a wise thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: Nietzsche was a German philosopher, a wise man or thinker.

clue.text: Awkwardly positioned, moves ship that's been raised and escorted

indicators.note: in a down entry, something raised is read from bottom to top, so it runs backwards

parts.note: to warp a ship is to haul it along by ropes

explanation.surface: Someone in an ungainly pose shifts a vessel that has been lifted and accompanied.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's been raised' turns WARPS into SPRAW. Warping is a nautical term for moving a ship by hauling on lines.
explanation.definitionFit: To lie spread out with limbs flung untidily is to be awkwardly placed.

clue.text: Hunted animal with a net, perhaps, then do nothing

parts.note: a stag is a male deer, a traditional quarry

indicators.note: suggests the words a net could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Trap a hunted beast in a net, then sit idle.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay inactive and fail to develop is to remain still like standing water.

clue.text: User of this revolver could get a jar

definitions.text: User of this revolver could get a jar

parts.words: User of this revolver could get a jar
parts.note: revolver suggests a gun and jar a shock, but it is a spinning device on which a craftsperson throws a pot

explanation.definitionFit: A ceramicist shapes clay on a rotating disc to make vessels like jars.

clue.text: Burning with fresh zeal after a bad start

indicators.note: the rearranged zeal comes after the opening pieces
the start of a word is its first letter
fresh suggests the word zeal made over anew

explanation.surface: Fired up with renewed enthusiasm after an unhappy beginning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a bad start' tempts you to read a poor beginning, but it gives A and the start of 'bad'; the 'fresh' zeal goes 'after' them.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on fire is alight with flames.

clue.text: Money found by scouts?

definitions.meaning: an ancient unit of weight and currency
scouts in sport or entertainment seek out gifted people

explanation.surface: Cash discovered by Boy Scouts.
explanation.definitionFit: The talent was a biblical coin, and gifted performers are sought by talent scouts.

clue.text: Foreign money in a foreign land

parts.note: argent is the French word for money

explanation.surface: Overseas currency held in another country.
explanation.definitionFit: Argentina is a South American country, foreign to the setter.

clue.text: Lacking purpose, but in France we get the point

parts.note: E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: It's pointless, but the French see what we mean.
explanation.definitionFit: Something futile is said to be of no worth or point.

clue.text: This animal crossing bars the way for pedestrians

definitions.text: This animal crossing bars the way for pedestrians

parts.words: This animal crossing bars the way for pedestrians
parts.note: a striped beast that lends its name to the British striped road crossing, whose bars mark a path for walkers

explanation.definitionFit: A zebra crossing in Britain is a pedestrian crossing painted with black and white stripes like the African animal.

clue.text: Clubs competing over three miles

definitions.meaning: a group of sports teams playing one another
an old measure of distance of about three miles

explanation.surface: Teams contest a race over a three-mile course.
explanation.definitionFit: A sports association of competing teams shares its name with an archaic unit of distance.

clue.text: Stakes raised for the defence

parts.note: stakes and raised suggest betting, but here posts are set upright to form a barrier

explanation.definitionFit: A barrier of upright wooden posts built for protection is a defensive enclosure.

clue.text: Make harder to fathom

parts.note: seems to mean make more puzzling, but fathom is also a measure of water depth

explanation.definitionFit: To make water greater in depth makes it harder to sound with a line measured in fathoms.

clue.text: Ardent, he may be following a cause

indicators.note: suggests the letters could be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: A passionate man might well be a devoted campaigner.
explanation.definitionFit: A supporter of a cause sticks to it, and the adjective means clinging or devoted.
